description: This Rust source file provides helper functions and data structures for managing OAuth client configuration files in the Google Cloud Console format. It includes structures for serialization/deserialization, functions to save and load configurations, and tests for these functionalities.

classes.name: InstalledConfig
classes.description: Represents the 'installed' application configuration from Google Cloud Console, including client ID, secret, project ID, URIs, and optional fields.

classes.name: ClientSecretFile
classes.description: Wrapper structure matching the JSON format used by Google Cloud Console for OAuth client secrets.

methods.name: client_config_path
methods.description: Returns the file path for the client secret configuration JSON.

methods.name: save_client_config
methods.description: Creates and saves a client configuration JSON file with provided client ID, secret, and project ID, setting appropriate permissions.

methods.name: load_client_config
methods.description: Reads and parses the client configuration JSON file into an InstalledConfig struct.
